title: Tourists in Our Own Backyard
subtitle: A mid-fall date at Authors’ Ridge in Concord
method: Original typographic compositions rendered with Pillow, with fine vector rules and installed URW P052 and Nimbus Sans fonts. PNGs contain no photographs, watercolor illustrations, logos, third-party artwork or synthetic family imagery. No font binaries are redistributed.
basis_for_creation_and_sharing: Owner-requested story package and standing An AUsome Life direction to create reviewed, exact-file organic-sharing assets for new outing stories. All promotional copy is original editorial text; the writer/professor and three-year context was confirmed by the owner.

sources.supports: Sleepy Hollow Cemetery location and hilly natural contours; Authors’ Ridge identification.
Paths and drives follow the land’s natural outlines; place history.

scoped_organic_sharing_intent.scope: Only the two exact reviewed PNG files listed here may be shared unchanged in organic social posts or Stories, with An AUsome Life / @anausomelife credit and the canonical article link. Excludes family photographs, watercolors, all other files, edits, paid advertising and implied endorsement.

visual_review.status: Both final PNG exports opened and visually inspected at native output sizes. Text, apostrophes, title, subtitle, location, caveat and credit are intact; no clipping, overlap or personal owner name. Dimensions and image descriptions checked against the exports.

account_verification.status: No venue or town social handles are used or assumed. Only the established publication credit is included.

publication_status.website: Included in the reviewed website source package; GitHub Pages records deployment status.
